caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk with a natural brown wood grain finish. The desk has three large drawers at the bottom, each adorned with two round, yellow or gold-colored handles. Above the drawers, there is a slanted front panel that folds down to form a writing surface, also supported by two additional pull-out supports with matching round handles. Inside the desk, visible when the writing surface is down, there are several small drawers and open compartments. The small drawers also feature round, yellow or gold-colored handles, and the open compartments have arched tops. The desk rests on four bracket feet, and the overall composition centers the desk on a plain, off-white background. The sketch is rendered in colored pencil or watercolor, showing detailed wood textures and hardware. There is faint cursive writing beneath the desk, partially legible with words such as “Sketch - ‘Hammond’ Desk 1780” and a signature “David S. DeVaut” (partially obscured).
title: Desk
